content:
Ana: quick sync — can we score/prioritize onboarding zephyr-70b? product wants a decision this week :eyes:
Mohit: can you drop the intake form + current perf baseline?
Ana: https://rwd-inf/board/INTAKE-zz (perm restricted)
Ana: baseline notes: currently using redwood-13b for chat, latency median ~120ms, cost baseline = 1x
Ana: intake summary:
```
model: zephyr-70b
intended: chat assistant (long context), code snippets
key asks: better helpfulness + factuality, not blow up latency >200ms
ops notes: estimated mem 28-32GB on A100-style, quantization target: 4-bit
```
Ana: quick scorecard (1-5, higher=better for helpfulness/factuality, lower=better for cost/latency impact)
```
helpfulness: 4
factuality: 3
latency-impact: 2  # adds ~80ms median in baseline run
cost-delta: 2      # ~1.6x token cost at fp16 baseline
quant-readiness: 3
regression-risk: 3
total: 17/30
```
Sophie: quick thought — seems product-benefit is real for complex completions. I'd run a 4-bit PTQ pass + kernel tune before infra reservation. That should cut cost to ~1.1x and latency closer to +30ms.
David: agree with Sophie. Add a strict gating rule: no >1% drop on our internal helpfulness/factuality evals. If regression happens, auto-fallback to 13B.
Mohit: infra note: current runtime needs a small kernel change for seqlen-1024 KV cache. If we add that, warmup latency will improve. We can prototype on a spare pod but need a ticket and ~3 dev-days.
Eva: proposing canary rollout: 5% traffic in staging for 48h, run continuous eval hooks (F1/helpfulness/factuality) and latency/cost telemetry. If all green, ramp to 25% with same checks. Fallback rule to 13B enforced.
Ana: gating checklist draft:
- perf bench vs 13B (latency, p50/p95)
- cost-per-1M tokens estimate
- quantized artifact that meets quality threshold
- canary + auto-fallback + alerting
- run 3 targeted eval suites (chat-qa, codegen-smoke, hallucination-tests)
Mohit: rough schedule if approved: prototype quant + kernel tune (2w), infra changes + canary infra (1w), eval + ramp (1w) -> total ~4w.
Sophie: experiment plan: run 4-bit PTQ then awq fine-tune on 2 small corpora (code + convo). Compare hallucination rate using our hallucination-suite.
David: priority ask: product said target for Q3 minor release. If we aim P1 we need to commit infra now. If P2 we run experiments only. My vote: P2 unless we get explicit product sign-off to absorb cost delta.
Ana: product rep (not in thread) said they can accept a 1.2x cost if latency stays <160ms. That pushes us toward P1 if Sophie’s quant plan works.
Eva: I can own the canary playbook and alerting hooks.
ci-bot: created ticket INFR-4321 for kernel changes and INTAKE-789 for model onboarding :white_check_mark:
Sophie: +1 on canary playbook and experiments.
Mohit: +1 but need the ticket to land before dev work.
David: +1 if we include the rollback flag and the 1% quality SLO in the ticket.
Ana: ok — outcome: move to 'experiment' lane (P1 tentative) pending quant results; Mohit/Sophie to start kernel + PTQ prototype, Eva to prep canary. Will reconvene end-of-week. :thumbsup:
Mohit: noted, starting ticket scoping today.
Sophie: I'll post initial experiment script + dataset pointers in thread when ready.
Ana: thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: if you agree, else comment.
Sophie: :thumbsup:
Mohit: :thumbsup:
David: :thumbsup:
Eva: :thumbsup:
